title: Serengeti: Frequently Asked Questions
excerpt: Frequently asked questions about the Serengeti: when to go, how long, where to stay and what you will see.
body:
## How big is the Serengeti?
Around 14,750 km².

## When is the best time?
All year. See [migration month by month](/blog/great-migration-month-by-month/).

## How many days?
Two to four nights. See [how many days](/blog/serengeti-how-many-days/).

## Will I see the migration?
Depends on timing and luck.

## Big Five?
Possible, but rhinos are rare here. See [Big Five](/blog/big-five-explained/).

## Getting there?
By road via Ngorongoro or by plane.

## Where to stay?
See [lodge or tented camp](/blog/lodge-or-tented-camp/).

## Is it safe?
Yes, with a guide.

## Balloon flight?
See [balloon safari](/blog/serengeti-balloon-safari/).

## Serengeti or Masai Mara?
See [comparison](/blog/serengeti-vs-masai-mara/).

[Plan your Serengeti safari](/travel-proposal/).
